transit.description: Graph-only node: ui and api-client ship raw source with no build script, so dependents hash their files through this edge

//#format-and-lint.description: Repo-wide biome check; uncached because root-task hashing misses workspace files

@opusline/web#build.description: Bundles the web app from the committed API client; no generate edge so CI's JS lane never needs PHP — pre-push and the spec-drift CI job guard freshness

@opusline/api#generate.description: Exports the OpenAPI spec from the Laravel app; uncached because openapi.json is committed source a cache restore must never overwrite

@opusline/api-client#generate.description: Generates the typed client from the OpenAPI spec; uncached because src/ is committed source a cache restore must never overwrite

check-types.description: Type-checks the package without emitting output

lint.description: Non-mutating format and refactor-drift checks for the package
